en.title: [Talent Development Team] Special Lecture Preparing for the National Civil Service Recruitment Exam (PSAT)
summary: A special lecture program organized by the Talent Development Team to prepare for the National Civil Service Recruitment Exam (PSAT)
Information session: Tue, Sep 29, 2026, 18:30–21:30, Hi-Tech Building Room 230
Mock exam and lecture: Sat Oct 31, Sun Nov 1, Sat Nov 7, 2026, 13:00–19:00, Student Union Building Room 346
Open to the first 50 applicants; textbooks and tuition are free

en.easyExplanation: The Talent Development Team is holding a special lecture to help students prepare for the National Civil Service Recruitment Exam (PSAT). There is no specific eligibility requirement stated, and it is open to the first 50 applicants; applications for the information session and the lecture must be submitted through separate links.
en.target: No specific eligibility requirements are stated in the notice; open to the first 50 applicants (선착순 50명) on a first-come, first-served basis.

originalContent:
[인재개발팀] 국가공무원 채용시험(PSAT) 대비 특강
* 교육일정 및 장소
- 설명회: 2026. 09. 29.(화) 18:30 ~ 21:30 / 하이테크 230호
- 모의고사 및 특강: 2026. 10. 31.(토), 11. 01.(일), 11. 07.(토) 13:00 ~ 19:00 / 학생회관 346호
- 대상인원: 선착순 50명(교재 및 교육비 무료)
* 프로그램 신청
- 설명회: https://m.site.naver.com/2hfGj
- 특강: https://m.site.naver.com/2hfH5
